page: Request ID Middleware for unique per-request ID generation. Import: {Hono} from 'hono', {requestId} from 'hono/request-id', type {RequestIdVariables} from 'hono/request-id'. Access request ID: c.get('requestId'). Default generation: crypto.randomUUID(). HTTP header: X-Request-Id (default, customizable). Custom ID support: pass ID in X-Request-Id header, middleware uses it instead of generating. Node.js requirement: crypto.randomUUID() requires Node.js 20+. Node.js adapter: auto-sets crypto globally. Options: limitLength (number, default 255), headerName (string, default 'X-Request-Id'), generator ((c: Context) => string). Platform-specific IDs: AWS Lambda, Cloudflare Ray ID, Deno, Fastly. Use generator function to capture platform request IDs. Type: RequestIdVariables for TypeScript. Questions: How to generate request IDs? How to access ID? Can I pass custom ID? Questions: What to import? Where is requestId located? What's RequestIdVariables?

Request ID middleware basic usage. app.use('*', requestId()). Simple one-line setup. Access with c.get('requestId') in handlers and middleware. Type support: import type {RequestIdVariables}, new Hono<{Variables: RequestIdVariables}>(). Infers c.get('requestId') type. Custom request ID: pass X-Request-Id header in request, middleware uses that value instead of generating. Example: headers: {'X-Request-Id': 'your-custom-id'}. Disable header support: set headerName option to empty string ''. Questions: How to enable request IDs? How to access? How to type correctly? Can I pass custom ID? How to disable header?

Request ID middleware options specification. Optional: limitLength (number, default 255, maximum ID length, longer IDs truncated). Optional: headerName (string, default 'X-Request-Id', header name to check/set for custom IDs). Empty string '' disables header checking. Optional: generator ((c: Context) => string, custom ID generation function, default crypto.randomUUID()). Return string value from generator. Allows custom formats, platform integration. Questions: How to limit ID length? Can I customize header? Can I generate custom IDs? What about async generators? What's the default generator?

Platform-specific request ID integration. Many platforms generate own request IDs: AWS Lambda (Context object), Cloudflare (Ray ID), Deno (unique IDs), Fastly (req.xid). Problem: middleware generates new ID unaware of platform IDs, confusion in logs. Solution: use generator function to capture platform ID. Example: generator: (c) => c.env.AWS_REQUEST_ID or Cloudflare Ray ID. Link references: AWS Lambda Context docs, Cloudflare Ray ID docs, Deno blog request IDs, Fastly req.xid docs.
